description: Get an AllTrails user's activity feed (recorded hikes and posts). Defaults to the signed-in user; pass a userId to target a specific public profile. Without a feed argument this returns the feed DIRECTORY (the available feeds: local, timeline (following), personal (own posts)) — pass feed to get the actual items. Returns slim projections by default; pass view:"full" for the whole records.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous page, for pagination

feed.description: Which feed to read: local (nearby activity), timeline (people you follow), personal (own posts). Omit to list the available feeds.

userId.description: Numeric AllTrails user id. Defaults to the signed-in user.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact returns { count, hasNextPage, nextCursor, items: [{ type, timestamp, description, user, trail, activity, review }] } — and the no-feed directory as { name, displayName } per feed; "full" returns AllTrails' whole records.

name: alltrails_get_activity_feed
